intro: Global e-commerce, web hosting, digital media, publishing, and technology sectors were the primary targets in a recent wave of WordPress-related vulnerabilities. Between April 13 and May 17, 2026, twelve articles covered a severity mix of five medium, four high, and three critical issues. Key CVEs include CVE-2026-6433 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2021-47926, CVE-2021-47927, CVE-2021-47929, and CVE-2021-47957, each with a CVSS score of 6.4. The impact was felt globally across these sectors.
